name: Baker theta (ベイカー シータ)
gf_detail: Baker theta is a 100% rice-flour bakery that uses no wheat flour at all; the venue and local press describe it as 「米粉100％の身体に優しいパン」 (100% rice-flour bread that is gentle on the body) and a グルテンフリーの米粉パン屋さん (gluten-free rice-flour bakery), with 小麦粉不使用 (no wheat flour used). Individual breads are additionally labelled 小麦不使用 (wheat-free) alongside egg/dairy flags, e.g. ガーリックフランス is 卵・乳・小麦不使用. Because the entire kitchen is rice-flour based there is no wheat on the premises to cross-contaminate, but one allergy-focused source advises 「コンタミについては訪問前に必ずお店に確認をお取りください」 (confirm cross-contamination directly with the shop before visiting), so a celiac should still confirm shared-equipment handling on arrival.
neighborhood: 上温品 (Kami-Nukushina), Higashi-ku, Hiroshima

gf_cross_contamination.text: Allergy-focused source explicitly advises confirming cross-contamination with the shop before visiting: 「コンタミについては訪問前に必ずお店に確認をお取りください」.
The entire bakery is 米粉100％ with no wheat flour used (小麦粉不使用), so there is no wheat on the premises to cross-contaminate.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: This is a rice-flour bakery, not a restaurant; soy sauce is not a featured ingredient and no wheat-based seasoning claims were found. Savory items such as mentaiko French and shio-koji chicken should still be checked for wheat-containing sauces.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Each product is individually labelled with allergen flags such as 卵不使用・乳不使用・小麦不使用 (egg/dairy/wheat-free), making allergen status easy to verify at the shop.

positives.text: 100% rice-flour bakery with no wheat flour used anywhere — 「米粉100％の身体に優しいパン」— which is unusually safe for celiacs.
Additive-free concept catering explicitly to egg and dairy allergies, with per-item allergen labelling.

name: CoCoRoBA (米粉ぱん CoCoRoBA)
gf_detail: A 100% rice-flour bread specialist that bakes no wheat at all. The shop's own site states 「国産米粉のみを使用し、余計な添加物を含まないグルテンフリーのおいしいパン生地作りに取り組みました」 and markets itself as a 「完全グルテンフリー米粉パン専門店」, using only domestic rice flour (Hiroshima Koshihikari + Kumamoto Mizuho Chikara blend). Curated GF guide komeko-palette confirms the facility 「小麦粉を一切使用していない」, eliminating cross-contact from equipment/utensils — no shared wheat line. Celiac-safe for the plain breads; note that cheese and chocolate varieties contain dairy (乳) though all items remain wheat- and egg-free.
neighborhood: 佐伯区利松 (Toshimatsu, Saeki-ku), Hiroshima

gf_cross_contamination.text: Facility uses only domestic rice flour and no wheat flour at all, fundamentally eliminating cross-contamination from equipment and utensils.
Shop describes itself as a fully gluten-free rice-flour bread specialist (完全グルテンフリー米粉パン専門店).

soy_sauce_wheat.text: Bakery, not a restaurant; savory toasts (tuna, mentaiko garlic) may use seasonings/sauces — celiacs should confirm those specific items, though plain breads carry no wheat.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Positioned explicitly for the three major food allergies (wheat, egg, dairy); allergy-aware operation.

positives.text: Entirely wheat-free premises — no wheat baking on site, the strongest cross-contact protection a bakery can offer.
Nationwide online shop lets celiacs order the same GF breads remotely.

name: Kotonoha (コトノハ)
gf_detail: A vegan and gluten-free baked-sweets workshop that uses no wheat at all. The shop's own site states 「小麦粉・卵・乳製品・白砂糖を使わず、米粉を使った焼き菓子」 and bills itself as a 〜Vegan & Gluten-free 工房〜 making treats 「誰でも安心して食べられる」. Everything is built on rice flour with no wheat on the premises, so cross-contact risk is minimal. This is a sweets-only shop (muffins, chiffon/pound cakes, cookies), not a place for a meal.
neighborhood: 安佐南区上安 (Kamiyasu, Asaminami-ku), Hiroshima — near Astram Kamiyasu Station

gf_cross_contamination.text: Bakes only with rice flour; no wheat flour used anywhere, so cross-contact risk in the workshop is minimal.
Self-described Vegan & Gluten-free 工房 making sweets without wheat flour, egg, dairy or white sugar.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: Sweets-only shop; no soy sauce / savory wheat seasonings involved.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Mission is snacks anyone can eat safely, including allergy sufferers; featured by allergy-focused guide alleco.

positives.text: Entirely wheat-free premises using only rice flour — strong protection against gluten cross-contact.
Nationwide shipping (free over ¥4,500) for the same vegan GF sweets.

name: Maimaiko (まいまいこ)
gf_detail: A 100% rice-flour bakery and sweets shop that uses no wheat at all. The shop's own listing states 「100％米粉(グルテンフリー)のお菓子とパンの店です。小麦粉アレルギーの方に配慮しており、小麦粉は一切使用しておりません。厨房の調理過程で小麦粉が混入することもありません」 (a 100% rice-flour gluten-free sweets and bread shop; considerate of those with wheat allergy; no wheat flour used at all; no wheat flour contamination during the kitchen preparation process). No evidence the shop also bakes wheat or serves barley beer, so it reads as a dedicated GF kitchen. Takeout only; naturally low cross-contact risk, though celiacs may still wish to confirm shared equipment/ingredient sourcing directly.
neighborhood: 草津東 (Kusatsu-higashi), Nishi-ku, Hiroshima

gf_cross_contamination.text: 「小麦粉は一切使用しておりません。厨房の調理過程で小麦粉が混入することもありません」 — no wheat flour is used at all, and there is no wheat flour contamination during the kitchen preparation process.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: Not applicable — this is a rice-flour bread and sweets bakery with no soy-sauce-based savory dishes; the concern here is wheat flour in baking, which the shop excludes entirely.

staff_allergy_handling.text: 「小麦粉アレルギーの方に配慮しており」 and 「小麦以外の食べ物アレルギーにも対応可能」 — the shop is considerate of wheat-allergy customers and states it can also accommodate non-wheat food allergies.

positives.text: Fully dedicated 100% rice-flour (グルテンフリー) bakery — no wheat used anywhere and explicit no-cross-contamination claim, making it suitable for celiacs.
Corroborated as a 米粉パン・スイーツ specialty shop by an independent Hiroshima gluten-free roundup.

name: CocoChouChou (ココシュシュ)
cuisine: Vegan & gluten-free sweets / patisserie (raw cakes, butter sandwiches, raw chocolate, cookies)
gf_detail: A fully dedicated vegan & gluten-free confectionery workshop where wheat flour is never used on the premises. The venue states 「小麦粉は不使用。米粉やアーモンドの粉などを使います」 (no wheat flour is used; rice flour and almond flour are used instead) and describes itself as 「卵・乳製品・小麦・白砂糖不使用、ヴィーガン＆グルテンフリーのお菓子」 (sweets made without egg, dairy, wheat, or white sugar). Because the entire product line and kitchen are wheat-free, structural cross-contact risk is very low, though the shop does not advertise formal celiac certification or lab testing, so confirming with staff is still wise for a highly sensitive celiac.
neighborhood: 北石堂町 (Kita-Ishidō-chō) — approx. 4–6 min walk from Nagano Stn, Zenkoji (善光寺口) exit

gf_cross_contamination.text: 小麦粉は完全不使用で、米粉やアーモンドの粉などを使用。工房全体がグルテンフリー専用のため小麦の混入リスクは構造的に極めて低い。
「卵・乳製品・小麦・白砂糖不使用、ヴィーガン＆グルテンフリーのお菓子」と全商品を明記。

soy_sauce_wheat.text: スイーツ専門店のため醤油・味噌など小麦を含む発酵調味料は使用しない。該当なし。

staff_allergy_handling.text: 店主はカフェ商品開発時に食物アレルギーを研究し、3大アレルゲン不使用スイーツの製造販売から創業。アレルギー対応が事業の中核。

positives.text: 小麦を一切扱わない完全グルテンフリー＆ヴィーガンの菓子工房で、全商品が対象。添加物も「できる限り使いません」。
全国にファンを持つ人気店で通販実績も豊富。長野駅善光寺口から徒歩数分とアクセス良好。

name: Enishi (縁-enishi- sorghum&glutenfree)
cuisine: Gluten-free bakery (sorghum & rice flour bread, scones, baked donuts)
gf_detail: A dedicated gluten-free specialty bakery using Shinshu-grown sorghum (ソルガム／タカキビ) and Kijimadaira rice flour. The shop states its products are made in a workshop that never brings wheat onto the premises — 「工房内では一切小麦を使わない」 and 「小麦は一切持ち込まないアレルギー対応の専用工房」 — with items labeled アレルギー28品目対応 and many marketed as 卵・乳・小麦不使用, explicitly aimed at children with wheat allergy. Because no wheat exists in the facility, gluten cross-contact risk is very low; the main caveat is that some baked goods do contain egg or dairy (so read each label), and shared display/handling is within an all-GF environment.
neighborhood: 若里 (Wakasato), Nagano City — ~15 min walk from Nagano Station east exit

gf_cross_contamination.text: 「工房内では一切小麦を使わない、三大アレルゲンフリーの丸パン」 — the workshop uses no wheat at all; rolls are free of the three major allergens.
「小麦は一切持ち込まないアレルギー対応の専用工房」— a dedicated allergy-response workshop into which wheat is never brought; products labeled アレルギー28品目対応.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: Bakery/sweets shop with no wheat on premises; wheat-based soy sauce is not a relevant ingredient here, and the workshop is wheat-free by policy.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Shop manager Misari Yamaguchi has a personal wheat-intolerance background and trained at a gluten-free café; founder Itaru Inoue started the sorghum business for his wheat-allergic son — allergy safety is core to the shop's purpose.

positives.text: Dedicated gluten-free specialty shop marketed as safe for wheat-allergic children, with items labeled to Japan's 28-allergen standard (アレルギー28品目対応) and 卵・乳・小麦不使用 options.
Confirmed open (opened 8 April 2023); Tabelog rating 3.00, address 長野県長野市若里2-1-23, phone 026-466-6610.

name: Riz Karuizawa (リズ カルイザワ)
gf_detail: A dedicated 米粉（rice-flour）gluten-free bakery in Karuizawa's Lake New Town — everything sold is gluten-free, with NO wheat flour used on the premises. The shop bakes 「グルテンフリーのパン」from 米粉 (specially-cultivated Koshihikari rice flour) with 白神こだま酵母; one source notes some breads also blend 大豆粉 (soy flour), which is still gluten-free. The owner trained under 大塚せつ子, a pioneer of Japanese rice-flour baking (「米粉の母」). Because it is a rice-flour-only kitchen, cross-contact risk is very low, but an allergen card is posted for milk/soy, so celiac guests can also confirm dairy per item.
neighborhood: Hotchi (Lake New Town), Karuizawa Town

gf_cross_contamination.text: Dedicated rice-flour bakery — no wheat flour used on premises, so cross-contact risk is very low.
Breads use 米粉 (Koshihikari rice flour) with 白神こだま酵母; some also blend 大豆粉 (soy flour), which is gluten-free.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Allergen reference board (food/milk) available in-store.

positives.text: 100% rice-flour, gluten-free bakery; listed as a gluten-free bakery on FindMeGlutenFree for Karuizawa.

name: Yamada Sanpou (山田三方)
gf_detail: Single-product wagashi shop selling 三方焼 (sanpou-yaki, a taiyaki-style filled cake). The owner announced (2024-03-03) that the entire line is now all-gluten-free: 「三方焼は【オールグルテンフリー】になりました。生地はすでに米粉で作っていましたが、中に入っているカスタードクリーム・チョコクリームも米粉を使用しています。」and adds 「小麦粉アレルギーの方にも安心して…お召し上がりいただけます。」The batter is rice flour (米粉) and even the custard and chocolate creams are rice-flour-thickened; anko is naturally wheat-free. This is the shop's own claim on a single product line, so no wheat flour should be on premises — but because it is a self-declaration (not a certified celiac facility), a parent should phone ahead (070-8978-0276) to confirm no wheat is handled anywhere before serving a celiac child.
neighborhood: 本町 (Honmachi), Iseshi Station front, Ise City

gf_cross_contamination.text: Owner's claim is that the entire single-product line is rice flour (米粉), including custard and chocolate creams, so wheat flour should not be present — but this is a self-declaration, not a certified allergen-controlled facility; confirm by phone for a celiac child.

staff_allergy_handling.text: 「小麦粉アレルギーの方にも安心して…お召し上がりいただけます」— shop states wheat-allergy customers can eat safely.

positives.text: Whole product line converted to all-gluten-free rice flour (batter + creams); anko naturally wheat-free.
2 minutes from Iseshi Station, on the main Ise Jingu approach route.

name: ミヤジマベース (Miyajima Base)
gf_detail: ⚠ Safety review 2026-07-02: downgraded dedicated→high. Open, legit, allergen-aware GF karaage/curry cafe (rice-flour karaage, GF soy sauce); celiac blogger ate safely, 'very clued up on celiac, separate oil.' But 'dedicated' fails: same source explicitly says 'NOT dedicated gluten free'; own page hedges 'MOST dishes' wheat/egg/dairy-free; 'separate' GF oil implies a non-GF fryer = shared-kitchen CC. — Prior note: A dedicated gluten-free cafe: every dish on the menu is made without wheat, egg, or dairy. The signature non-fried rice-flour karaage uses rice flour and gluten-free (wheat-free) soy sauce, and they fry it in separate, dedicated oil to avoid cross-contact. The owner is a former dietician who developed the recipes and pays close attention to seasonings. Staff are knowledgeable about celiac disease and adjusted their practices (switching to gluten-free soy sauce) after feedback from a celiac customer. Widely regarded by celiac travelers as the safest place to eat on Miyajima.
neighborhood: Miyajima (behind Itsukushima Shrine toward Momijidani Park; ~5 min walk from the shrine)

gf_cross_contamination.text: They fry the karaage in separate, dedicated oil so there is no cross-contact.
The entire menu is free of wheat, egg, and dairy, so there are no gluten-containing dishes prepared in the same kitchen.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: They use gluten-free (wheat-free) soy sauce; seasonings are also wheat-free.
The owner, a former dietician, developed the recipes and is careful about seasonings being wheat-free.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Staff are very knowledgeable about celiac disease and changed their practices (adopting gluten-free soy sauce) after learning from a celiac customer.
The owner worked about ten years as a dietician across schools, hospitals, and corporate cafeterias before opening the cafe.

positives.text: Described as probably the best place for celiacs to eat anywhere on Miyajima Island, with carefully prepared, excellent karaage.
All meals are wheat-, egg-, and dairy-free and recommended for those seeking a gluten-free meal.

name: ニニン (ninin)
cuisine: Plant-based / gluten-free coffee stand and cafe
gf_detail: ⚠ Safety review 2026-07-02: downgraded dedicated→high. Real open plant-based + GF cafe, self-branded プラントベース・グルテンフリー (own claim OK). The owner explicitly checks that plant milks and other ingredients contain no wheat, and a documented anecdote describes a parent telling their allergic child that they could choose anything in the shop. No formal cross-contamination protocol is published, so travelers with celiac disease should confirm preparation details on arrival, but the entire menu is built around being wheat-free.
neighborhood: Hakushima-kitamachi, Naka Ward, Hiroshima (right by JR Shin-Hakushima Stn)

gf_cross_contamination.text: The entire menu is wheat-free, so there are no wheat-flour products in the kitchen, but no formal celiac cross-contamination protocol has been published.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The owner explicitly verifies that plant milks and ingredients contain no wheat, choosing only wheat-free products; a documented anecdote describes a parent being told their allergic child could safely choose anything in the shop.

positives.text: A dedicated plant-based and gluten-free cafe — every item is made without eggs, dairy, or wheat, so vegan and gluten-free guests can order anything on the menu.
Sweets are also made without white sugar, artificial coloring, or preservatives.

cuisine: Gluten-free rice-flour café — bread, sweets, koji deli lunch

gf_cross_contamination.text: Branded a gluten-free / rice-flour café with no documented wheat items, but no explicit cross-contamination/allergen policy is published — confirm whole-menu wheat-free scope on reservation.

positives.text: Instagram bio: 「グルテンフリーカフェ/米粉パン」 — gluten-free café / rice-flour bread.
「グルテンフリーのスイーツが楽しめるカフェ」 — a café where you can enjoy gluten-free sweets.

name: Tamari Ya RICE DONUT (田万里家 ライスドーナツ ekie広島駅店)

neighborhood: ekie KITCHEN 1F, 広島駅 (Hiroshima Station), 南区, Hiroshima

gf_cross_contamination.text: No wheat is used in any product; the shop is a rice-flour donut specialist, so facility-wide wheat cross-contact is low. No published dedicated-fryer statement — confirm shared-oil status on the day.

positives.text: 「生地は小麦を使用せず、全てグルテンフリーです」 — dough uses no wheat and is entirely gluten-free; eggs are not used.
ekie press release: 「生地は小麦を使用せず全てグルテンフリー」, additive-free, rice-bran oil, pesticide-free own rice.

name: comecome (こめこめ)

gf_detail: comecome is a 米粉のシフォンケーキ屋 (rice-flour chiffon cake shop) working out of a renovated house; its cakes are made with 米粉 (rice flour), きび砂糖 (unrefined cane sugar), 有機豆乳 (organic soy milk) and 米油 (rice oil) — the venue's own Japanese description is "米粉の他に、きび砂糖や有機豆乳、米油などこだわりの食材で作られた…家庭的なシフォンケーキ", with no wheat flour named. neighborhood: 峰高 (Minetaka), Hatsukaichi

gf_cross_contamination.text: Rice-flour chiffon specialty shop; no wheat products found, but no published cross-contact protocol — celiac should confirm no wheat is handled and ask about baking powder / shared equipment.

positives.text: Made with rice flour (米粉), organic soy milk (有機豆乳), rice oil (米油) and unrefined cane sugar (きび砂糖) — no wheat flour named in the shop's description.

name: Komeko Udon Undo (米粉うどん製麺所 undo／あんど)
cuisine: Rice-flour udon noodle shop / gluten-free noodle factory

neighborhood: 中区大手町 (Otemachi, Naka-ku, Hiroshima)

gf_cross_contamination.text: Dedicated rice-flour udon operation using 100% domestic rice flour; the shop states 「小麦粉不使用」 (no wheat flour used). No formal cross-contact/allergen protocol has been published, so confirm equipment is not shared with any wheat item.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: The shop states 「出汁やタレなどもすべてグルテンフリー」 (the dashi, sauces and tare are all gluten-free), implying wheat-free soy/tare; confirm the specific bowl's tare is the gluten-free one.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The business was created specifically to serve gluten-free and vegan tourist demand, so staff are accustomed to allergen questions; no written allergen policy published.

positives.text: 100% domestic rice-flour noodles; all dashi and sauces advertised as gluten-free — a genuine celiac-safe savory meal.

name: Cafe Fuwafuwa (Cafe ふわふわ)
gf_detail: A rice-flour pancake specialty café — every pancake is 米粉100%, so there is no wheat flour and no wheat pasta on the premises (the seed's 'shared pasta menu' does not exist; the savory items are also rice-flour pancakes). The venue's own claim: 「100％米粉を使った、ふわふわのパンケーキ」 and 「パンケーキは、米粉100%使用と砂糖を減らすことにより…罪悪感なく食べられるギルトフリー」. neighborhood: 大町市大町・文化会館サン・アルプス大町棟内 (Omachi, near 北大町駅 / Omachi Cultural Hall, on the Hakuba route)

gf_cross_contamination.text: Entire pancake range is 米粉100% (100% rice flour); no wheat flour or wheat pasta is used on the premises, so batter-level cross-contact is inherently low. However no formal celiac cross-contact protocol is published.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: Savory pancakes such as ハーブ鶏の照り焼き (herb-chicken teriyaki, described as 甘じょっぱい / sweet-salty) and the Shinshu salmon plate use teriyaki/soy-based sauces that are wheat unless tamari — a celiac should confirm the sauce or choose the sweet pancakes.

staff_allergy_handling.text: No published allergy/celiac handling protocol found; the shop markets 'gluten-free pancakes' but is not a certified celiac kitchen. Communicate celiac disease directly at ordering.

positives.text: Concept is 100% rice flour with no wheat flour on premises, plus reduced sugar, soy-milk cream, organic local produce and Nagano red sorghum — a genuinely rice-flour-first kitchen, unusual on the Hakuba route.

name: Harutonari (ハルトナリ。)
gf_detail: A gluten-free sweets café (opened 13 April 2025) whose baked goods are all made with Nagano-grown rice flour and no wheat. Local press describes it plainly as 「グルテンフリーのカフェ」 and 「小麦粉を使わない米粉のスイーツ」 (a gluten-free café; rice-flour sweets that use no wheat flour), and the cakes are also white-sugar-free. A curated Japanese GF guide independently confirms it is prepared 「完全に独立した厨房で調理」 (in a completely separate/independent kitchen) and that 「小麦不使用の調味料を厳選」 (wheat-free condiments, i.e. tamari-style soy, are used), which supports celiac-safe status. gf_cross_contamination.text: GF guide states the food is 「完全に独立した厨房で調理されており、グルテンフリーの安全性を確認しています」 (cooked in a completely independent kitchen, gluten-free safety confirmed).
Operator claim: 「すべてのメニューがグルテンフリー」— no wheat flour anywhere; udon is 玄米 (brown rice) and fry batter is 米粉 (rice flour), so the fryer handles only GF batter.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: GF guide notes 「小麦不使用の調味料を厳選」 (wheat-free condiments carefully selected), indicating tamari-style / wheat-free soy and tsuyu.

staff_allergy_handling.text: GF guide advises: 「グルテンフリー以外のアレルギーがある場合は、事前にお店へ確認してください」 (for allergies other than gluten, confirm with the shop in advance).

positives.text: Whole menu is gluten-free with a separate/independent kitchen — a rare celiac-safe sit-down option in the Arashiyama tourist core.
Run by an established 32-store café group (パンとエスプレッソと / 株式会社日と々と), suggesting consistent operating standards.

name: COrPO (やさしいスイーツカフェ COrPO)
cuisine: Gluten-free cafe — rice-flour bread, lunch plates, tarts & parfaits

Wheat flour is not used or brought onto the premises; the rice-flour bread is 100% 米粉 (Kumamoto rice flour) with 「小麦粉一切不使用」, and even lunch seasonings are stated to be entirely gluten-free. gf_cross_contamination.text: Dedicated gluten-free specialty shop: 「小麦を使用しない、全てグルテンフリーの商品を提供しております」— no wheat is used and all products are gluten-free; outside food is banned except certified wheat-free baby food.
Rice-flour bread is 100% 米粉 with 「小麦粉一切不使用」 (no wheat flour whatsoever).

soy_sauce_wheat.text: All lunch seasonings are stated to be gluten-free (「調味料もすべてグルテンフリー」-style claim), consistent with the shop's wheat-free premises.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Positioned explicitly for people with wheat/flour allergy and gut-health goals; the whole operation is wheat-free by design.

positives.text: Entire menu — breads, lunches, sweets — is gluten-free; wheat flour is neither used nor brought onto the premises.
Uses no wheat flour and no refined white sugar, with organic-leaning sourcing.

gf_detail: en-kitchen is an entirely wheat-free vegetable cafe: the venue describes itself as a 「卵・牛乳・小麦粉を使用しない野菜カフェ」 (vegetable cafe that uses no eggs, milk or wheat flour), and its own claim is that 「店内の全てのメニューが小麦・卵・乳製品不使用…調理器具も完全に分けており、小麦粉の持ち込みは一切禁止」 (every item on the menu is wheat/egg/dairy-free, cooking utensils are completely separated, and bringing any wheat flour onto the premises is strictly forbidden). Bread is baked from 米粉 (rice flour) rather than wheat, and Japanese reviewers confirm that non-allergy-safe food may not be brought into the shop (アレルギー対応でない食品の持ち込みは禁止). Because the whole kitchen is wheat-free this is one of the safest options in Nagoya for celiacs, but as always confirm seasoning details (tamari vs. wheat soy sauce) with staff on the day.
neighborhood: 中区大井町 (Higashi-Betsuin, Naka-ku, Nagoya)

gf_cross_contamination.text: Venue's own claim: 「店内の全てのメニューが小麦・卵・乳製品不使用…調理器具も完全に分けており、小麦粉の持ち込みは一切禁止」 — every menu item is wheat/egg/dairy-free, utensils are completely separated, and no wheat flour may be brought onto the premises.
The entire cafe uses no wheat flour (卵・牛乳・小麦粉を使用しない野菜カフェ); bread is made from rice flour (米粉パン), so there is no in-house wheat baking to cross-contaminate.
Japanese reviewers note that food not compliant with the cafe's allergen policy may not be brought into the shop (アレルギー対応でない食品の持ち込みは禁止).

soy_sauce_wheat.text: The whole menu is declared wheat-free, which implies any soy-based seasoning is a wheat-free type (tamari); this was not explicitly documented, so celiacs should confirm on the day.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Owner Chiaki has managed food allergies since childhood; the shop is built around allergen-free (卵・牛乳・小麦不使用) cooking.
Reviewers advise contacting the cafe in advance if you have specific allergy or ingredient concerns (アレルギーや食材が気になる方は事前に問い合わせを).

positives.text: 100% wheat-free kitchen with separated utensils and a ban on wheat flour entering the premises — very low celiac cross-contact risk.
Owner has lifelong personal experience of food allergies, so allergen handling is a core focus.
Kids' plate excludes the 27 major allergens, indicating serious allergen-management practice.

cuisine: Gluten-free rice-flour bakery & cafe (bagels, bread, lunch)
gf_detail: A 100% rice-flour bakery and cafe with no wheat on the premises — the venue states 「小麦・卵・乳不使用、米粉を100%使用したグルテンフリーのパン」 and 「メニューはもちろん全てが"グルテンフリー" 小麦・卵・乳不使用のランチを２種類ご用意しています」. Aichi's first rice-flour bagel specialist; owner Eriko Kondo is a registered dietitian (管理栄養士). Every item — bagels, bread, and both lunch sets — is wheat/egg/dairy-free, so cross-contact risk is inherently very low. As with any bakery, confirm current allergen handling directly if you have a severe reaction, but this is a genuinely dedicated GF facility.
neighborhood: 千種区萱場 (Kayaba, Chikusa-ku, Nagoya)

gf_cross_contamination.text: 100% rice-flour bakery with no wheat used anywhere; the venue states 「小麦・卵・乳不使用、米粉を100%使用したグルテンフリーのパン」, so cross-contact from wheat is not a factor on the premises.
Cafe menu is entirely wheat/egg/dairy-free: 「メニューはもちろん全てが"グルテンフリー" 小麦・卵・乳不使用のランチ」.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: Lunch plates are declared wheat-free, implying no standard (wheat-based) soy sauce is used; confirm the seasoning on the day if highly sensitive.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Owner is a registered dietitian who develops products with individual allergy responses in mind.

positives.text: Dedicated wheat/egg/dairy-free facility — nothing containing wheat is made or sold on site.
Aichi's first rice-flour bagel specialist, run by a registered dietitian using domestic rice flour.

name: Komeko no Mise Palette (こめこの店Palette)

gf_detail: A dedicated gluten-free rice-flour bakery/cafe near Ozone/Morishita. This is a genuinely dedicated, celiac-oriented facility.
neighborhood: 北区東大杉町 (Higashi-Osugi-cho, Kita-ku, Nagoya — near Ozone/Morishita)

gf_cross_contamination.text: Venue states 「製造施設内への小麦の持ち込みは完全禁止、米粉パン専用の設備・器具のみを使用し、コンタミネーション（混入）リスクはゼロ」 — wheat completely banned from the facility, rice-bread-only equipment, zero contamination risk.
MAFF Tokai regional 米粉店 mapping and Tabelog list it as a rice-flour/gluten-free specialist.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: As a wheat-free facility, savory items (gyoza/shumai) avoid wheat-based components; confirm the dipping sauce/seasoning is tamari-based or wheat-free if highly sensitive.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Whole-facility wheat ban reflects an allergy-first operation aimed at children and the wheat-sensitive.

positives.text: Explicit zero-contamination claim: wheat banned from the facility, rice-only equipment.
Additive-free bagels from 100% domestic rice flour, natural yeast, natural salt, kibi sugar and rice oil.

name: Michinori-tei (みちのり亭)
cuisine: Gluten-free Japanese washoku and Nagoya-meshi set meals (teishoku/gozen)
gf_detail: A fully dedicated gluten-free washoku restaurant opened 22 Nov 2024 by the Michinori Bento team (founder 'naco' has a severe wheat allergy), and it is DISTINCT from the takeaway bento shop. The venue's own claim is 「小麦はもちろん、大麦、ライ麦、オーツ麦など、グルテンを含む穀物を一切使用しない」 (uses absolutely no gluten-containing grains — not just wheat but barley, rye and oats). Corroborating JP coverage reports 「調理器具も完全に分けていて、小麦粉の持ち込みは一切禁止」 — cooking equipment is fully separated and no wheat flour is allowed on premises; breading is rice flour (米粉) and seasoning uses wheat-free tamari, with soy/miso/dashi verified wheat-free. Only caveat: they note some third-party condiment factories may also handle wheat, so extremely sensitive celiacs are advised to confirm the specific item on arrival.
neighborhood: 中村区椿町 (Tsubaki-cho, Nakamura-ku) — Nagoya Station West exit / Taiko-dori side

「小麦はもちろん、大麦、ライ麦、オーツ麦など、グルテンを含む穀物を一切使用しない環境を徹底しています」 — the establishment rigorously maintains an environment free of every gluten grain (wheat, barley, rye, oats).
Caveat noted by coverage: 「一部調味料の製造工場では小麦を扱っている場合があります。重度の小麦アレルギーの方は、来店前にお店へ直接ご確認いただくことをおすすめします」 — some condiment factories may also process wheat, so severe sufferers should confirm directly.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: Uses wheat-free tamari soy sauce (グルテンフリー醤油) for marinating and seasoning instead of standard wheat-containing shoyu; seasonings (醤油, 味噌, だし) are verified for wheat content.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The owner 'naco' has a severe wheat allergy and personally set up the separated-kitchen, no-wheat-flour operation, so staff understand allergen safety firsthand.
The venue's site states 「厳選された食材と独自の品質管理で、小麦アレルギーの方にも安心してお召し上がりいただけ」 — carefully selected ingredients and proprietary quality management make it safe for those with wheat allergy.

positives.text: Entirely gluten-free menu — every dish, including fried Nagoya specialties, is made without any gluten grain using rice-flour breading.
Full-service sit-down washoku restaurant (28 seats) a 3-minute walk from Nagoya Station west exit — a genuine celiac-safe full-meal option, not just takeaway.

name: A double prime (a″／エーダブルプライム)

Run by registered-dietitian sisters, so allergen awareness is high; because every product is rice-flour based there is no wheat cross-contact risk in-house, though standard shared-oven/utensil caveats for a small kitchen apply. Barley/rye are not part of the baking, but confirm any bought-in decorations if extremely sensitive.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: Not applicable — this is a sweets/baked-goods shop; no soy-sauce-based savory dishes.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The baker is a registered dietitian (管理栄養士), and the shop is built entirely around gluten-free rice-flour baking.

positives.text: 100% rice-flour, fully gluten-free product line — one of the safest celiac sweet stops in Nagoya.
Also sold at Social Tower Market pop-ups as 『米粉のスコーン・焼き菓子』.

name: Gluten Free BITTE (グルテンフリーBITTE)

soy_sauce_wheat.text: Bakery (breads and chiffon cakes) — soy sauce not a factor in the product line.

positives.text: Entire facility is wheat-free/GF (no wheat baked on premises), founded and run by a celiac-adjacent (gluten-intolerant) owner.
Per-item allergen labelling for wheat, egg and dairy.

name: Kashiya Fujinomiya (菓子屋 藤ノ宮)

gf_cross_contamination.text: Company states the entire factory switched to fully wheat-free production in summer 2022: 「完全に小麦を使わないグルテンフリー食品製造を行うことにいたしました」 — no wheat product line remains on premises, so cross-contact risk is very low.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The shop is expressly built around wheat-free customers (celiac / wheat allergy) and its whole raison d'être is gluten-free confectionery, indicating high staff awareness of wheat avoidance.

positives.text: Curated Japanese celiac guide empacede rates it グルテンフリー ★★★★★, describing it as carrying no wheat products with no cross-contamination risk.

「当店の商品はすべて小麦・乳製品・卵不使用です」 — every product is made without wheat, dairy or egg.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: Not applicable — bakery; no soy-sauce-based dishes served.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The entire shop is purpose-built as an allergen-free (wheat/dairy/egg) bakery, so allergen avoidance is the default operating model rather than a special request.

All products are simultaneously gluten-free, dairy-free and egg-free — fully suitable for celiac and vegan diners.

name: Miinas (ミーナーズ)
cuisine: Gluten-free organic cafe — rice-flour bagels, rice burgers, wraps, plates & sweets
gf_detail: Miinas brands itself as a グルテンフリー・オーガニックカフェ (gluten-free organic cafe); owner Minami Kenmi told Himeji Keizai Shimbun the food is 「オーガニック食材やグルテンフリーを意識した内容」 (content mindful of organic ingredients and gluten-free), aiming to 「オーガニック食やグルテンフリーを日常の選択肢として広げたい」. Because every product is 米粉-based there is no wheat flour on premises, but this is a tiny home-scale operation that opened 7 Nov 2025 and also runs rice-flour bread classes; there is no published celiac cross-contact protocol, so highly-sensitive coeliacs should confirm mix-in ingredients (some bagels use cheese, bacon or chocolate) and any shared equipment.
neighborhood: 紀寺町 (Kidera-cho), Naramachi south, Nara City

name: laccola (ラッコラ)
cuisine: Gluten-free vegan patisserie / rice-flour sweets, canelé, cookies, amazake
gf_detail: Wholly gluten-free & vegan patisserie — the shop states 「すべての商品がグルテンフリー」 (all products are gluten-free) and 「植物由来の材料だけで」, made without wheat, eggs, dairy or refined sugar. Baking is done with rice flour (and oats/oatmeal) and no wheat flour is used on the premises, so cross-contact from wheat is inherently very low. However, the shop publishes no explicit celiac cross-contamination protocol, and the use of oats (naturally GF but commonly wheat-cross-contaminated unless certified) is a caveat for sensitive celiacs — hence high rather than dedicated.
neighborhood: 西大寺東町 (Saidaiji, Nara City)

name: Chiffon no Mise PUKKU (シフォンのお店 PUKKU)
gf_detail: 米粉シフォンケーキ専門店 — a rice-flour chiffon specialist where every cake is 100% rice flour and wheat-free. The shop states its signature 「100年しふぉん」 is 「米粉100%のグルテンフリー」 and describes its baking as 「小麦粉不使用（グルテンフリー）」, using 九州産米粉 plus 吉野本葛 (Yoshino kudzu) and 170-year-old 米飴 rice syrup. No wheat is baked on premises, so cross-contact risk from flour is low; however the attached café also serves a lunch (まんPUKKUランチ) whose full-menu gluten-free status is not individually documented, and there is no explicitly published celiac cross-contact protocol — hence high rather than dedicated. Celiacs should confirm the lunch/morning items are also 米粉 before ordering.
